import logging.config
import logging.handlers


logging.handlers.SocketHandler("localhost", 9000)
logging.handlers.HTTPHandler("localhost", "/events")
logging.handlers.DatagramHandler("localhost", 9000)
logging.handlers.SysLogHandler()
logging.handlers.SMTPHandler(("localhost", 25), "from", ["to"], "subject")
logging.config.listen(9030).start()
